decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 3rd Energy Store (ES) 3rd Control Electronics (CE) Components of a different specification have been changed whilst under Parc Ferme. All Power Unit elements were replaced with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 28.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article 28.3. The use of each additional element in this case carries a 10 grid place penalty therefore there is an accumulation of 20 places. Article 42.3 d) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations provides that a driver which has accrued more than 15 cumulative grid position penalties must start from the back of the grid. However, as components have also been changed to those of a different specification than used in qualifying Car 22 must therefore start the race from the pit lane as specified by Art. 40.9(a).
rules_referenced: Article 28.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
